prompt_diff: * reset(state): restore all mutable state needed to repeat the workload from the same starting point, including model/optimizer initial state, random generators, caches and counters. Preserve the source's division between setup and timed work: if it clears gradients or resets a cache inside the timed invocation, keep that operation inside run rather than pre-clearing it in reset. This runs outside the measured workload. For stateless inference it may be a no-op if run creates its own request-local state. Do not destroy the process group.

* run(state) -> result: execute the entire frozen workload and return its output. A training workload must include the full accumulation, required communication and optimizer update. A generation workload must produce the full declared token count with the same sampling/greedy semantics. The framework measures wall time surrounding this call, with CUDA synchronization at both boundaries.

* observe(state, result) -> nested dict/list/tuple of tensors and scalar values: outputs needed for correctness. Classification includes every logit and predicted token/class integers; generation includes generated tokens and the same required full logits/scores as the source; training includes loss, all gradients and updated parameters. Return detached tensors, not hash-only or sampled outputs. Do not put elapsed times or performance counters into correctness observations.

+Per-rank tensor tolerance comparisons do not enforce relationships between outputs or participants. Implement the source-defined relational correctness checks in observe(), outside timed run(), and expose exact boolean/integer observations or raise on violation. Preserve the full required observations. Declaring a required relationship only in understanding.json is insufficient.

* metrics(state, result, elapsed_ms) -> dict of finite numeric values: expose the frozen objective and useful project metrics in their native units. Derive throughput from the unchanged work amount and elapsed_ms. Any subphase objective such as TTFT must use the source's actual completion boundary, CUDA synchronization/events as appropriate, and return its measured value. Keep the full workload even when the objective measures one phase. Additional metrics are allowed; do not fabricate measurements.

* models(state) -> dict[str, torch.nn.Module]: expose loaded root model(s) for automatic discovery and controlled replacement. Return an empty mapping for a pure functional project. Do not preselect operator groups or optimization targets.
